Title: General Availability: Performance workbooks for Azure PostgreSQL - Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Get comprehensive monitoring experience for your Azure PostgreSQL - Flexible Server instance with Azure monitor workbooks. Built on the Azure Workbooks, you can now create a visual report for server metrics within the Azure Portal. The integration offers two templates for monitoring the service: Overview and Enhanced Metrics. The templates can be edited and customized according to your requirements and pinned to the dashboard for a focused view of Azure resources. 

For more information, please visit Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible - Monitor workbooks documentation.
